reviews.text: Poor vetinarian service, they only want you to pay, they have very and I mean very little compassion for your pet. Just your pocket!!! This is a true experience.
Staff are very welcoming and approachable treat barny and myself with the up most care would highly recommend oakfield
Very friendly helpful staff. Easy to get appointment.
Very good can't fault  very good as always
we have used oakfields for many years now through several pets always excellent service and wonderful staff.
Good vets but abit pricey

I would like to say thank you for the staff who come to my aid with regards my 16 year old dog Rocky who Was in so much pain an made the heartbreaking decision I had to make 💔.  The staff were very helpful an caring put my Rocky first no mention regards payment just concerned that Rocky was to come first an appointment was made to see him that day after the disgusting disrespectful way I was treated by pdsa ,I tried other veterinary services but Oakfeild were unbelievable genuinely so caring I couldn't fault them one bit.  The whole veterinary team are the best...So a big thank you from my heart am treated Rocky with love an kindness in this time of heartbreak.
Quite a long wait even though we had an appointment (about 45 mins), but the vet we saw was really lovely and helpful

The staff are lovely. They all know there stuff and every visit goes really well. No pushy sales or anything. The pricing is reasonable and is cheaper then some vets I've used before. I would 100% recommend Oakfield Vets!

I telephoned for an appointment to be told there was none available for that day and to call back in the morning at 8am ( For a minute I thought I had accidentally called my GP). I did this as requested promptly at 8am the next morning to be told there were no appointments yet again and the next available appointment would be in October which is well over a month and more away. I was told there were appointments available at the branch in Tamworth but no appointments in Atherston. The person I spoke to on reception appeared to have a very cold and uncaring attitude and slightly rambled on to inform me that they only had one vet at the practice. I find this totally unacceptable when my dog needed to see a vet and chose this branch as it was in close proximity for me when I first had my dog. I should have aired on the side of caution when I was told sometime ago by a friend that this practice is not the best as they tried to call when their dog collapsed and the practice never answered the telephone. I have since moved practice and although a little further for me it was worth my time in doing so.
Such a wonderful team, they treat my nervous, emotional spaniel with so much patience and kindness, I wouldn't go anywhere else. All the staff are amazing.

Good vet, great staff.

It isn’t in Castle Bromwich though, it’s in Kingshurst. Not sure why they say Castle Brom.

Trip to Oakfield vets with my poorly dog. They got me in the same day and were very thorough. He’s not back to fighting fit yet but we have a plan. The vet was excellent. I also benefitted from having a monthly plan as I got discounts too.

My experience of many visits to Oaklands @ Castle Brom over the years has been one empathy, informative and unfailing professional support  from senior vet, Dr. Mikella Petsa, the nurses and reception staff. Especially when our blue roan of 15 years was helped gently out of his aged body at the end of things .
Dr . Mikealla has left the practice now( Jan ‘26) but hopefully her colleagues will continue in the same vein .
The staff are always, friendly and caring when dealing with my dog. They ask questions about how things are before starting any procedures.

Needed to see a vet , went late afternoon and was told to come back at 5.30 . Toby was seen by a lovely vet and the receptionist was just as nice . So caring , gentle and professional . Highly recommend this practice.

We have been at Oakfield’s practice for many years with all our animals from Rabbits Cats and dog.
All the staff have been kind helpful.
My latest visit was for Archie our cat, Even though it was a weekend and staff were not the staff we are  use to I  was very happy, there’s a plan and I left reassured everything was being done. Many thanks

My little girl Shadow (dog) went missing for 36 hours, someone was looking down on me and she was found! My usual vets was closed, Oakfield had emergency appointments, I rang promptly and with the hour she was brought back to us she was also seen by the vet. Amazing service! Can not thank them enough!!
Can't fault any of the staff. Friendly, polite and we had a laugh. Everything was fully and clearly explained and informed of the cost. WELL DONE!! Meow!!
My border collie is a very nervous girl , I dread going to vet . The guy was fantastic, put myself and border collie at ease ,
The Vet, Malwina was caring, nonjudgmental and compassionate. She was so good at handling my poorly cat, which gave me confidence that Luna was being well cared for and in a safe pair of hands.
I have been going to oakfield for 9 years with my shi zu beethoven, would not go anywhere else  never had a problem with staff xxx
First time using the vets and I got the wrong day I was a day early but they still seen my dog very happy
Just lovely staff and very helpful
They are good and they look after  pets and aslo help people if you dont under stand  any thing that why can help to talk to people.

My Rocky was 16yrs old an was in so much pain and I believe that this was the hardest thing ever I've had to do. After trying other veterinary practice who turned me an Rocky down. I rang Oakfield veterinary. Who told me that they would see Rocky. The staff were absolutely amazing caring an gentle with every aspect of the appointment sadly Rocky was put sleep. I appreciate all the staff who supported me in Rockys last breath.
thank you!

Thank you for taking the time to leave us as review. If there is anything you feel we could improve on, please do not hesitate to get in touch.
Kind regards,
Oakfield Vets

I have always found the staff very compassionate and very helpful.Their love of animals shines through and their care for the owners is really heartwarming too ,their warmth is very touching  and supportive. We had to say goodbye to our beautiful zena last week and all the staff there helped us through a really difficult time , they made an unbearable experience more bearable  ,couldn't fault them .The care that they have given zena over the years has been exceptional and I want to thank all the vets that have played a big part in that during and at the end .

I just wanted to say how pleased I was with my recent visit. The care was excellent, and every member of staff I met was friendly, professional, and genuinely kind. It’s always reassuring to walk into a place where you feel welcomed and looked after so well.

I do have to say, though, that I really miss Makala. She was such a lovely person — warm, gentle, and incredibly professional. Her caring nature always shone through, and she had that rare ability to make both pets and owners feel completely at ease. She’s very much missed, and it’s a testament to the standard she set that the team continues to deliver such a high level of care.

Please pass on my thanks to everyone. It was a very good visit, and I truly appreciate the work you all do.
